parsed.explanation: No trans-specific presentation offence, facility ban, or border rule is documented, and facilities/custody are open questions, not exposures. Severity if outed is nevertheless high: sections 146/148 criminalising male same-sex conduct, up to 10 years, were actively upheld by the High Court in Feb 2024, providing a live secondary lever - illustrated in 2019 when a cross-dressing assault victim was charged with fraud for 'pretending to be a woman', withdrawn without reason. A July 2023 58-page report documents bias-motivated violence and discrimination in daily life; 2018 cross-dressing men were attacked and 2011 comments sought murder. Society is stigmatised/invisible, with no SOGI anti-discrimination protection, LGBT organisation or helpline, so tier-3 hostility has thin/no recourse. Thin data extrapolates toward that insecurit y, tempered by no documented organised police targeting or universal facility exclusion.
